About the Portland Gear Hub Thursday Group Ride group ride

Portland Gear Hub Thursday Group Ride is a road and social group ride in Portland, ME. It rolls every Thursday at 6:00 pm from Portland Gear Hub.

A social-pace road ride north or south of the peninsula with ice cream or beach stops. Four routes rotate by week: Higgins Beach, Falmouth, Kettle Cove, Tuttle Loop. There is no sweep, so know the route and be able to fix a flat. Ride whatever bike you have.
